verdict.rationale: Blaxel has a dedicated docs page for creating point-in-time sandbox snapshots, rolling back to a checkpoint, and forking snapshots into new sandboxes, which covers every element of the story (blaxel-docs-21). Related docs on archive/unarchive and snapshot storage expiration policies support the persistence side (blaxel-docs-22, blaxel-docs-25). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on the SDK/API mechanics of snapshot restore and fork (the evidence is only one-line doc summaries).
